notes.subject: תדמיוני/ונדמה
notes.rationale: Wanem as (damah) i stat na pinis ves — pasin bilong paslain, lus long Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: Yahwe i tok long ol man bilong Babilon
notes.rationale: Ol askim olsem sena — Yahwe i singaut olgeta man.

notes.subject: askim bilong Yahwe
notes.rationale: Askim i holim man: long husat bai yu skrumim mi?

translation: Long husat bai yu skrumim mi, na mekim i wan wantaim mi, na tokaut long mi olsem tok bilong piksa, na bai ⟨em⟩ i kamap wan?

tokens.gloss: na tokaut long mi olsem tok piksa
